inline-commit: the evidence the project's checks don't hold
holding only files the change wrote, staged by name
auto-commits: the instruction to commit each diff
retitle: one job per unit, one home per fact
one-branch: later work on top unless asked apart
one-branch-apart: one branch off the one it merges into
two-diffs:
- **Done:** <commit subject, marked uncommitted if it is; if the work stopped short, that first>
- **Waiting on:**
flaky-commit: fails before the fix on every run
one-branch-trunk: Commit where the work can still be reviewed
